name: sdlc-capm
description: Turns basic requirements and Figma screens into an approved PRD, BRD, test cases and Jira stories, with a human review at every step.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sdlc/ui && npm run build -w @sdlc/cli && npm run build -w sdlc-capm-vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/vscode-extension
scripts.package-extension: npm run build && npm run package -w sdlc-capm-vscode
